sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; stale junior-member purchases from mid-2021; market fear (44 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory conviction or recent news data.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (459.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent FOMC event, and negative macro score (-6) create severely adverse conditions for real estate equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX strong trend confirmation + MACD bullish crossover + SAR bullish alignment provide technical momentum entry signal in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
